rec.name: FAQ Section with Category Tabs and Thumbnail (Variant 2)
rec.status: Built — launched (documented; product image supplied for docs)

what.text: A custom Shopify FAQ section ("CRO | FAQ with Tabs") for the Impact theme. It shows a heading and subline, an optional thumbnail/product image beside (left or right) a white card of accordion questions. Questions can be grouped by category, with pill-shaped filter tabs above the accordion (a "Filter" label plus buttons such as General, Recipe, Intake, Shipping). The first category can act as an "All questions" view. Each Category block holds its own FAQ items. The accordion uses +/– icons, and the answer text opens beneath the question.

why.text: Unanswered questions at the point of decision cause hesitation and drop-off. Surfacing answers to common objections (origin, price justification, dosage, shipping) in a scannable accordion lowers perceived risk and support effort without crowding the page. Category filters let shoppers jump to the topic they care about, which reduces cognitive load on long FAQ lists. A product image alongside keeps the visual context and brand feel. The card with shadow lifts the FAQ from the background and makes it feel like an interactive tool.

how.text: Create the snippet ed-cro-faq-section-two.liquid and the matching section in the theme (Impact). The section uses CSS custom properties driven by section and block settings, with separate mobile and desktop values (breakpoint 1000px for layout, 768px for text). Blocks: Heading (rich text heading with a highlighted word), Content (subline) and Category blocks (each containing FAQ items). Tabs use a custom element (skb-universal-tabs-wrap) with horizontally scrollable pill buttons. The active tab gets a configurable background and text colour. FAQs use a custom collapsible element (ed-collapsible) with a toggle button, plus/minus icon rotation and bordered rows. Layout: flex row on desktop with the thumbnail taking a set width percentage (default 40%), stacked on screens under 1000px. Enable "Group FAQ's by category" to show the tabs, and "Multiple accordions open at once" to allow several open answers. The code file in the ticket is truncated (the plus-icon rule is cut off), and the JS for the tabs and collapsible is not shown.

items: Custom max-width toggle and max-width (default 1200px)
Text colour and section background colour
Vertical alignment of thumbnail vs. content (Top / Center)
Thumbnail image, position (Left/Right), width % and corner radius
Group FAQs by category (tabs on/off)
Multiple accordions open at once (on/off)
Tab label text (e.g. "Filter")
Content box background colour, shadow on/off, corner radius, border colour
Active tab button colour and text colour
Tab text size, question title size, answer text size (desktop and mobile)
Section top/bottom spacing (desktop and mobile)
Heading block: font, size, line height, letter spacing, alignment, transform, colour, max width, spacing (desktop and mobile)
Content block: font, size, line height, letter spacing, alignment, colour, max width, spacing (desktop and mobile)
Category blocks, each with its own FAQ items (question + rich-text answer)

dependencies.text: Shopify OS 2.0 theme (built for "Impact"). Relies on theme settings (heading_color, text_color, background) as fallbacks. Needs a custom-element JS for tabs and collapsibles (not included in the visible code excerpt). The original ticket also required accessibility (keyboard navigation, ARIA), no external JS plugin, and no duplicate tabs for multi-assigned questions. Whether these were fully implemented can't be verified from the excerpt.

items: PDP conversion rate and add-to-cart rate
FAQ interaction rate (accordion opens and tab clicks per session)
Support ticket and contact-form volume for covered topics
Scroll depth to the FAQ
Bounce/exit rate on pages with the FAQ
Revenue per visitor

images.caption: Reference design (edubily): product image left, white card with a Filter row of pill tabs (General active) and accordion questions with +/– icons
Final desktop render: heading with highlighted word, subline, thumbnail left, white shadowed accordion card with first answer open

Theme editor, desktop: section settings (max-width, colours, thumbnail, group by category, multiple open, label, shadow) and the Heading / Content / Category block tree, with the filter tabs shown in the preview
Mobile preview: thumbnail stacked above the card, tab pills and touch-friendly accordion
Editor with 'Group FAQ's by category' off: tabs hidden and all questions shown in one list; a second background colour setting applied
